hook.description: Short Japanese hook line for the short-video caption. No URL, no hashtag -- those are added deterministically by code.

content_type.description: Which post format this slot uses, copied from top LINE creators' social formats (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-28-line-sticker-loop-design.md, 'Social formats copied from top creators'): daily_life = a relatable everyday moment for the character; seasonal_hook = a moment tied to the current season/event; reaction_pick = a 'which one do you send?' style pick between a couple of the clips; showcase = the existing sticker-sample format. Rotate so the same account does not show the same type on consecutive slots.

beat_texts.description: For content_type daily_life/seasonal_hook/reaction_pick: one short Japanese text overlay per clip, in clip order, telling a 2-4 beat mini-story/reaction. For showcase return an empty array (required by structured-output strict mode).
